category_title: Highly reserved and anxious students with significant writing avoidance
minimal_context: The student is sitting with a blank sheet of paper during independent writing time in the writing workshop.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our writing workshop. Please start your independent writing on your blank sheet of paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits staring at the blank sheet of paper with a worried look, almost a scowl. Writes a word or two and then erases them.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to keep writing. What do you think you should write next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns her head away and shrinks in her seat, not speaking a word.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let me help you get started. (Approaches and touches her on the shoulder)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moans with apparent anxiety, turns her head, and shrinks further in her seat.)
